panels.title: Apparent Wind Speed
panels.description: sensor.nmea_aws — the boat's own masthead instrument reading, not corrected for boat motion.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "Sisu")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor.nmea_aws")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> yield(name: "aws")

panels.title: True Wind Speed
panels.description: sensor.nmea_tws — boat-instrument-computed true wind (MWV reference T), corrected for boat motion. 'No data' if the instrument only ever sends apparent.

targets.query:

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor.nmea_tws")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> yield(name: "tws")

panels.title: Wind Speed Intensity — Last 24 Hours
panels.description: Every raw apparent-wind-speed reading over the last 24h, bucketed by speed. Bright bands show where the wind actually sat; a lone hot cell high up is a gust, not the norm.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "Sisu")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor.nmea_aws")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 2m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "sensor.nmea_aws")

panels.title: Wind Rose — Apparent Angle (AWA + AWS)
panels.description: sensor.nmea_awa (MWV R, 0°=bow) stacked by sensor.nmea_aws (masthead, knots). 36 petals at 10°, bow up. Calm (<2 kn) is the center readout, not a petal color. Follows the dashboard time picker.

targets.query:
dir = from(bucket: "Sisu")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor.nmea_awa")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "wind_direction" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])
spd = from(bucket: "Sisu")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor.nmea_aws")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "wind_speed" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_field", "_value"])
union(tables: [dir, spd])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.wind_direction and exists r.wind_speed)
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "wind_direction", "wind_speed"])
  |> yield(name: "rose")

from(bucket: "Sisu")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")

  |> yield(name: "sensor.sisu_air_temp")

from(bucket: "Sisu")

panels.title: Barometric Pressure
panels.description: sensor.sisu_barometric_pressure — modeled (Met.no), no barometer fitted on the boat.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "Sisu")
  |> range(start: -6h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor.sisu_barometric_pressure")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> yield(name: "pressure")

panels.title: Pressure Trend (3h)
panels.description: Now vs. ~3h ago. A steady fall is the classic front-approaching signal — worth more than the raw number.

targets.query:
cur = from(bucket: "Sisu")
  |> range(start: -30m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor.sisu_barometric_pressure")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "cur" }))
old = from(bucket: "Sisu")
  |> range(start: -3h30m, stop: -2h30m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor.sisu_barometric_pressure")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "old" }))
union(tables: [cur, old])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_measurement"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with delta: r.cur - r.old }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "delta"])
  |> yield(name: "delta")

from(bucket: "Sisu")
  |> range(start: -6h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor.sisu_humidity")
